situation: `/phil:autopilot 30` in a GitHub repo whose CLAUDE.md reads, under "Workflow": open a pull request, merge once its pipeline passes, then run `/phil:done` to close the card. The card is open, in Todo, unassigned, with no worktree.
must_not: list a close, or /phil:done, on the AUTHORIZED line
drop the /phil:done step from the printed path
name the /phil:done step as the next step
run or launch any step of the path
why_this_fixture_exists: D13: the developer inspects and approves the work before anything calls it done, so a path that names `/phil:done` still authorizes no close.
